title: World Famous Lover
desc: An anthology of four inspiring love stories that showcase the diverse perspectives towards love that are prevalent among the different strata of human society.

title: Raja Rani
desc: Two people enter an arranged marriage to please their parents, living as strangers under one roof. However, an unforeseen event prompts them to reassess their relationship and emotions.

title: Sulthan
desc: Sultan, a motherless child, is raised by a group of criminals working for his father. However, when his father dies, he decides to reform the group into better people.

title: Saattai
desc: Dayalan, a teacher, tries to change the ongoing malpractices in a government school. Unfortunately, his acts are not welcomed by a few senior members and students, which leads to a rift between them.

title: Shakthi Thirumagan
desc: After his mother is mercilessly killed, young Kittu is adopted by an elderly man. As he grows older and is left to look after himself, he resolves to find his mother's killer.

title: Theeran Adhigaaram Ondru
desc: Theeran, a dedicated police officer, pays the price for his honesty and faces hardships when he tries to investigate the illegal activities conducted by a powerful gangster.

title: Bhanumathi
desc: An NRI medical student falls in love with a vivacious young woman whom he met at a wedding. However, several personal differences create complications in their relationship.

title: Ek Niranjan
desc: Kidnapped as a child, Chotu grows up to become a police informer whilst searching for his biological parents. However, his life takes an unexpected turn when he falls in love with Sameera.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Maska
desc: Krish weaves up a love story between him and Meenu to make a rich girl, Manju, fall for him. However, trouble begins when he realises that he has developed feelings for Meenu.

title: Karuppu Durai
desc: Karuppu Durai, an elderly man, runs away from home after learning his family's plan to kill him using euthanasia. His life takes a turn when he meets a young, orphaned boy.

title: Naa Saami Ranga
desc: A man gains great notoriety in his village for his unmatched strength and brutal nature, which makes him a target of antisocial elements with a ruthless agenda.

title: Kondraal Paavam
desc: The life of a poverty-stricken family becomes more complicated after an unanticipated visitor who goes by the name Arjunan, enters their household.

title: Ragalai
desc: Karthik's mother decides to marry him to her brother's daughter Indu. However, when the uncle insults Karthik's family, he goes on a mission to destroy him.

title: Silukkuvarpatti Singam
desc: Police constable Shakthi prefers a laid back approach to his job and tries to actively stay away from danger. But he is forced to change this attitude when he inadvertently jails a wanted don.

title: Ivan Veramathiri
desc: Guna kidnaps Eeswaran, brother of a minister, for orchestrating violence among students. However, Eeswaran escapes and trails after Guna to exact his revenge.
